title: A Goldilocks definition of sexual selection: a comment on Janicke
content: Sexual selection has been a contentious topic since its proposal, so it is unsurprising that debate continues over its definition. Janicke (2024) offers a thoughtful contribution to the recent debate—whether the definition of sexual selection should include competition for non-gametic resources. This is timely and welcome since a consensus remains elusive, despite recent attempts (Shuker and Kvarnemo 2021).
